physicalNotes: Radius 0.72 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Persson et al. 2018, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-216 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...618A..33P/abstract): 500,904 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.7 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Persson et al. 2018, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-216 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...618A..33P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4503 +/- 69 K from Persson et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-216 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...618A..33P/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
